organization: Administrative Conference of the United States (ACUS)
public_contact_or_submission: public input portals and published institutional contact
why_relevant: publishes recommendations and model rules on agency process; currently solicits public input on processing public comments in rulemaking and on adjudication, which is the residual in effect terms
notes: use the public input channel and the published institutional address, not personal staff addresses

public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and annual meeting
why_relevant: interdisciplinary community with Collaborative Research Networks; the setting where rule enforcement and discretion are studied empirically
notes: annual meeting is a presentation route; do not treat membership as agreement

public_contact_or_submission: journal route listed on the association site
why_relevant: publishes empirical and theoretical work on law in action, including enforcement and discretion; accessible through the association's public site
notes: journal information is linked from the LSA homepage; check current submission instructions before sending

public_contact_or_submission: section page with contact and program information
why_relevant: purpose is to promote communication on the law relating to the federal and state administrative process; runs annual New Voices programs
notes: this is a community entry point, not a submission portal; use for scoping a refuter, not for pitching

field: formal and computational models of legal reasoning
public_contact_or_submission: author submission portal linked from journal home
why_relevant: explicit scope covers formal or computational models of legal knowledge, reasoning and decision making; the natural venue for exceptions and default rules in institutions
notes: submissions need technical, empirical or formal contribution; doctrine-only papers are out of scope

why_relevant: open ground-visible route; recent listings include decision-record sufficiency and LLM compliance with employment law under contextual pressure, which are the same residual in another vocabulary
notes: preprints are not peer reviewed; a referee here is a reviewer, not corroboration

public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and research consortium
why_relevant: Rule of Law Index measures Regulatory Enforcement using more than 214,000 household and expert surveys across 44 indicators; a per-case, per-category instrument rather than one aggregate
notes: use the public contact page; an index is a budget filter, never a witness for a particular ruling

public_contact_or_submission: public resource page linked from AALS
why_relevant: listed among AALS dean resources; useful for locating the subfield and the people who would actually read a claim about rules and discretion
notes: mapping aid rather than a contact point; included for venue discovery
